title: "09 - Symptom Analysis (Revised 2016-2025)"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")

# Upstream requirement:
#   01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd -> Chik_total
#
# Revised scope: confirmed chikungunya only, 1 Jan 2016 through 31 Dec 2025.
# This file is descriptive/supporting analysis only. The symptom figures are
# intended for the supplement after the revision; they do not define the
# severity surface or vaccine-allocation metric.

STUDY_START_YEAR <- 2016L
STUDY_END_YEAR   <- 2025L
STUDY_START_DATE <- as.Date("2016-01-01")
STUDY_END_DATE   <- as.Date("2025-12-31")
STUDY_LABEL      <- "2016-2025"
SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR <- 2017L

stopifnot(
  exists("Chik_total"),
  all(Chik_total$CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) >= STUDY_START_DATE),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) <= STUDY_END_DATE)
)

symptom_map <- c(
  FEBRE      = "Fever",
  MIALGIA    = "Myalgia",
  CEFALEIA   = "Headache",
  EXANTEMA   = "Rash",
  VOMITO     = "Vomiting",
  NAUSEA     = "Nausea",
  DOR_COSTAS = "Back pain",
  ARTRITE    = "Arthritis",
  ARTRALGIA  = "Arthralgia",
  DOR_RETRO  = "Retro-orbital pain"
)

symptom_vars <- names(symptom_map)

chik <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(
    DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI),
    year = lubridate::year(DT_SIN_PRI),
    age_years = as.numeric(age_years),
    across(
      all_of(symptom_vars),
      ~ dplyr::case_when(
        as.character(.x) == "1" ~ 1L,
        as.character(.x) == "2" ~ 0L,
        TRUE ~ NA_integer_
      )
    )
  )
```

This revision treats symptom variables as **reported clinical features among
confirmed cases**, not as population incidence. Missing/unrecorded symptom
fields are retained as missing rather than being silently coded as absence.

## Overall symptom frequency and recording completeness

```{r symptom-frequency}
symptom_frequency <- chik %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(symptom_vars),
      list(
        present = ~ sum(.x == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        recorded = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
        missing = ~ sum(is.na(.x)),
        prevalence = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("symptom", ".value"),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    symptom_label = unname(symptom_map[symptom]),
    prevalence_percent = 100 * prevalence,
    missing_percent = 100 * missing / nrow(chik)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prevalence_percent))

print(symptom_frequency)

p_symptom_frequency <- ggplot(
  symptom_frequency,
  aes(x = prevalence_percent, y = reorder(symptom_label, prevalence_percent))
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Reported symptom frequency among confirmed chikungunya cases, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    subtitle = "Denominator for each symptom is cases with that field recorded",
    x = "Cases reporting symptom (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_symptom_frequency
```

## Recording completeness by year

```{r symptom-missingness-by-year}
symptom_missing_year <- chik %>%
  select(year, all_of(symptom_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(symptom_vars),
    names_to = "symptom",
    values_to = "present"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cases = n(),
    n_recorded = sum(!is.na(present)),
    missing_percent = 100 * mean(is.na(present)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(symptom_label = unname(symptom_map[symptom]))

print(symptom_missing_year)

p_symptom_missing <- ggplot(
  symptom_missing_year,
  aes(x = year, y = symptom_label, fill = missing_percent)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Missing (%)", option = "C") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Symptom-field missingness by year, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p_symptom_missing
```

## Symptom profile over time

Symptom-field completeness was extremely low in 2016 (approximately 0.9%
recorded) but was near-complete from 2017 onward. Therefore, all temporal
symptom analyses are restricted to 2017-2025. The yearly percentages are
descriptive proportions among cases with the relevant symptom field recorded.
Logistic time-trend models are retained only as compact diagnostics and are not
interpreted causally.

```{r symptom-trend-over-time}
symptom_year <- chik %>%
  filter(year >= SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR) %>%
  select(year, all_of(symptom_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(symptom_vars),
    names_to = "symptom",
    values_to = "present"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(present)) %>%
  group_by(year, symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    n_recorded = n(),
    n_present = sum(present == 1),
    prevalence_percent = 100 * mean(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(symptom_label = unname(symptom_map[symptom]))

print(symptom_year)

p_symptom_year <- ggplot(
  symptom_year,
  aes(x = year, y = prevalence_percent, group = symptom_label)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ symptom_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Reported symptom proportions by year, ",
                   SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR, "-", STUDY_END_YEAR),
    subtitle = "2016 excluded from temporal analysis because symptom fields were ~99% missing",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Cases reporting symptom (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_symptom_year

symptom_trend_models <- purrr::map_dfr(symptom_vars, function(sym) {
  d <- chik %>%
    transmute(year, present = .data[[sym]]) %>%
    filter(
      year >= SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR,
      !is.na(present)
    )

  fit <- glm(present ~ year, data = d, family = binomial())
  tt <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

  tt %>%
    filter(term == "year") %>%
    transmute(
      symptom = sym,
      symptom_label = unname(symptom_map[sym]),
      odds_ratio_per_year = estimate,
      conf_low = conf.low,
      conf_high = conf.high,
      p_value = p.value,
      n_recorded = nrow(d)
    )
})

print(symptom_trend_models)
```

## Complete symptom records

For co-occurrence and combination analyses, restrict to cases for which all ten
symptom fields were recorded. This ensures that a zero means an explicitly
recorded absence rather than an unrecorded symptom field.

```{r complete-symptom-records}
complete_symptom_cases <- chik %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(symptom_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

cat("Cases with all 10 symptom fields recorded:",
    nrow(complete_symptom_cases), "\n")
```

## Symptom co-occurrence (supplement)

The UpSet plot is restricted to complete 10-symptom records so that symptom
absence is not conflated with missingness.

```{r symptom-upset}
symptom_list <- lapply(
  symptom_vars,
  function(sym) which(complete_symptom_cases[[sym]] == 1L)
)
names(symptom_list) <- unname(symptom_map[symptom_vars])

upset_input <- UpSetR::fromList(symptom_list)

UpSetR::upset(
  upset_input,
  sets = colnames(upset_input),
  order.by = "freq",
  nintersects = 40,
  point.size = 3,
  line.size = 1,
  number.angles = 30,
  sets.x.label = "Complete-record cases reporting symptom",
  text.scale = 1.3
)
```

## Most common fully observed symptom combinations

```{r symptom-combination-table}

combo_df <- complete_symptom_cases %>%
  count(across(all_of(symptom_vars)), name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / nrow(complete_symptom_cases),
    percentage_label = paste0(
      scales::comma(n), " (",
      scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 0.1), ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

cat("Cases with all 10 symptom fields recorded:", nrow(complete_symptom_cases), "\n")
print(head(combo_df, 25))
```

## Symptom profile by sex among confirmed cases

These are **within-case symptom proportions**, not population incidence rates.
No external sex denominator is used because the numerator spans ten years of
notifications and a single-year census denominator would not represent the
person-time at risk.

```{r symptom-by-sex}
symptom_sex <- chik %>%
  filter(CS_SEXO %in% c("M", "F")) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = recode(CS_SEXO, "M" = "Male", "F" = "Female")
  ) %>%
  select(sex, all_of(symptom_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(symptom_vars),
    names_to = "symptom",
    values_to = "present"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(present)) %>%
  group_by(sex, symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    n_recorded = n(),
    n_present = sum(present == 1),
    prevalence_percent = 100 * mean(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(symptom_label = unname(symptom_map[symptom]))

print(symptom_sex)

p_symptom_sex <- ggplot(
  symptom_sex,
  aes(x = symptom_label, y = prevalence_percent, fill = sex)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Reported symptom profile by sex, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cases reporting symptom (%)",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_symptom_sex
```

## Symptom profile by age group among confirmed cases

```{r symptom-by-age}
chik_age <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_years), age_years >= 0) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_years < 15 ~ "<15",
      age_years < 30 ~ "15-29",
      age_years < 45 ~ "30-44",
      age_years < 60 ~ "45-59",
      TRUE ~ ">=60"
    ),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("<15", "15-29", "30-44", "45-59", ">=60"))
  )

symptom_age <- chik_age %>%
  select(age_group, all_of(symptom_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(symptom_vars),
    names_to = "symptom",
    values_to = "present"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(present)) %>%
  group_by(age_group, symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    n_recorded = n(),
    n_present = sum(present == 1),
    prevalence_percent = 100 * mean(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(symptom_label = unname(symptom_map[symptom]))

print(symptom_age)

p_symptom_age <- ggplot(
  symptom_age,
  aes(x = age_group, y = symptom_label, fill = prevalence_percent)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Cases reporting\nsymptom (%)", option = "C") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Reported symptom profile by age group, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Age group",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p_symptom_age
```

## Scope sanity checks

```{r scope-sanity}
cat("Study period:", STUDY_LABEL, "\n")
cat("Confirmed chikungunya cases:", nrow(chik), "\n")
cat("Years represented:", paste(sort(unique(chik$year)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Cases with complete 10-symptom recording:", nrow(complete_symptom_cases), "\n")
cat("Female/male-coded cases:", sum(chik$CS_SEXO %in% c("F", "M"), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Cases with non-missing age:", sum(!is.na(chik$age_years)), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(chik) == nrow(Chik_total),
  min(chik$year, na.rm = TRUE) >= STUDY_START_YEAR,
  max(chik$year, na.rm = TRUE) <= STUDY_END_YEAR,
  all(symptom_frequency$recorded + symptom_frequency$missing == nrow(chik)),
  all(symptom_year$year %in% SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR),
  min(symptom_year$year) == SYMPTOM_TREND_START_YEAR,
  n_distinct(chik$year) == length(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR)
)
```
